criteria.reason: Provides some sourced numbers but omits required WHO 4.7 million deaths and one-in-six resistance figures.
Clearly states repeated courses add up and resistant bacteria can spread to family/community.
Points to doctor but also gives a test-first rule; does not explicitly say doctor decides.
Practical, respectful, gives script and urgent warning signs.

summary: Useful practical numbers and resistance explanation, but misses required WHO AMR figures and explicit doctor-decides framing.
